items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: In fact, Walter White came there one night with Joe Fulco, and I introduced him to Mr. Cobb.

ctx.x: What years were you at the pavilion about? Was it 32? According to your clippings there, I think it was. 32 to 34. Well, that's not, I think that was the years that you had there.

Well, those were my biggest years when I played in Biloxi, because I was that good at Walter White. I was like, Mr. Cobb used to keep us in the summertime just to have us in the winter. But when he found out that I wanted to go to the White House, he arranged it. In fact, Walter White came there one night with Joe Fulco, and I introduced him to Mr. Cobb.
